messages:
Sam (Support): hey team, customer Acme just reported they get a 403 when trying to access the Project Console after we completed the org-split yesterday. they could view the project before, and invoices/deploy buttons now return permission denied. copying repro below.

Sam (Support): steps to reproduce from the customer's user (org-admin role originally):
1) Login via SSO (ok)
2) Navigate to org -> projects -> click Project: acme-payments
3) Click 'View billing' or 'Trigger deploy' -> immediate 403 with 'permission denied' banner

Sam (Support): customer pasted curl that shows the error:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -X GET "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/acme-payments/console" \ 
  -i
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "message": "User lacks projects.view console scope for project acme-payments"
}
```

Sam (Support): they say they are in group 'acme-admins' which used to map to Org Admin. after the split there were new org ids. they can still access some org-level pages but specific project routes fail. 

Marta (CSE): @Sam thanks — do we have the customer's SSO-provided role claim? sometimes claim mapping breaks if the org id changed. I can ask for SAML assertion but prefer we triage first.

Priya (Infra): pinging infra-auth. quick checks: 1) Did role inheritance get disabled during split? 2) Are project ACEs (access control entries) still pointing to the old org/group ids? 3) Any sync job errors yesterday?

Chen (Identity): looking at the sync logs for acme on 1918762000 - 1918768000 window. there was a group migration job that ran and returned 200 but with warnings: 'skipped mapping for group acme-admins: unknown org-ref org_OLD_1234'. That would explain missing project-level bindings.

Sam (Support): ok that matches customer timeline. they said they saw a banner "Org migration completed" yesterday. so mappings probably didn't get reattached. customer is on SSO SAML with SCIM group provisioning.

Priya (Infra): immediate mitigation options:
- Reattach the group to the new org id (backend change) — requires identity team approval and small DB write.
- Add the user's email to a temporary project-level role manually.
- If customer is urgent, create a short-lived invite link (project admin) so they can rejoin and regain access.

Chen (Identity): I can re-run the mapping job for acme-admins with manual mapping to new org id org_NEW_8765. need approval: this will write ACEs referencing org_NEW_8765 and may affect other projects in that org. @Marta can you confirm customer's acceptance?

Marta (CSE): confirmed with Acme product owner, they want us to re-map acme-admins to the new org_id. they want minimal disruption — prefer not to add users individually. go ahead.

Priya (Infra): Chen, once you push mapping, I'll force a permission cache invalidation for acme-payments so changes are immediate. plan: mapping write + cache invalidation + smoke test.

oncall-bot: permission-reindex job queued for org_NEW_8765 (job id pr-5592). estimated runtime ~ 45s.

deploy-bot: NOTE: There are in-flight deployments in acme-payments; updating ACEs will not cancel in-progress jobs.

Chen (Identity): mapping applied: mapped acme-admins -> org_NEW_8765 (manual override). response: 200. ACEs created: projects/acme-payments -> role:project.admin -> principal:group:acme-admins.

Priya (Infra): cache invalidation done for project acme-payments, permission reindex completed (pr-5592).

Sam (Support): asking the customer to retry — they report access restored and billing/deploy buttons working. :tada:

Sam (Support): followups for postmortem: need to add a guard to the org-split flow to detect SCIM group refs that point to previous org ids and auto-queue a mapping job, or at least flag and notify the customer's admin. also add an operational doc for manual remap steps.

Marta (CSE): I'll open an action item with the customer saying we restored mapping and will add safeguards. also we should surface a warning in the console when migration completes if group mappings are unresolved.

Chen (Identity): logging note: performing manual mapping leaves an audit entry: "identity.manual_map acme-admins old:org_OLD_1234 -> new:org_NEW_8765 by Chen". storing as long-term audit.

Priya (Infra): adding task to infra backlog: detect stale group refs after org operations.

Sam (Support): closing thread after customer confirms. tagging as resolved but recommend follow-up postmortem ticket. cc @everyone who helped. :heart:
